titleText: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears
mainText: From The Malta Independent: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears. Maltese authorities have issued an international arrest warrant for Ralph de la Torre, the former Steward Health Care chief who has yet to turn up to face charges over the hospitals deal.

titleText: Birkirkara local council says Civic Centre has no room for police station
mainText: From MaltaToday: Birkirkara local council says Civic Centre has no room for police station. There is no room for a police station in the town's Civic Centre, the Birkirkara local council has said on Friday, citing an agreement that sets out the building's use.
